title: NEPA Match Night
tagline: 85th minute. Super Eagles level. Then the light goes, and whoever fixes it owns the night.

host.label: Host of the night
host.tip: Everybody is in your sitting room. Charm gets easier, and you cannot slip away.

guest.label: Guest in their house
guest.tip: You are on their turf. Bluff is off the table.

chair.label: Best chair
chair.tip: Comfortable and calm. Wisdom gets easier.

floor.label: Behind the pillar
floor.tip: You cannot see the screen. Wisdom gets harder.

won_bet.label: Won the bet
won_bet.tip: Confidence is up. Hustle gets easier.

owes.label: Owes ₦500
owes.tip: You cannot raise any bets, and Hustle gets harder.

blamed.label: Blamed for the bad luck
blamed.tip: The room is looking at you. Charm gets harder.

fixer.label: Generator fixer
fixer.tip: The room trusts you. Charm gets easier.

text.default: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. The whole compound screams. You and {rival} both know that whoever brings the match back will host everyone for the rest of the night.
text.coop: The Super Eagles are level in the 85th minute and NEPA chooses this exact moment to strike. The whole compound is screaming. You and {partner} have about a minute to get something running before the match is over.

stakes.default: Hosting the viewing for the rest of the night.
stakes.coop: Saving the match for the whole compound.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the neighbour with the generator
Run to the junction for fuel
Shout until the whole compound mobilises
Check if it is just your fuse

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks the neighbour into carrying his generator over. {loser} is now politely asking if there is space on the sofa.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk the neighbour into carrying his generator over.

recap.default: {winner} runs to the junction and comes back with fuel, and their own generator roars. {loser} walks into someone else's party.
recap.coop: You run to the junction and come back with fuel, and the generator roars.

recap.default: {winner}'s shouting pulls the whole compound into the street to follow the match on one phone. {loser} gets pushed to the back.
recap.coop: Your shouting pulls the whole compound into the street to follow the match on one phone.

recap.default: {winner} finds out it was just the fuse and has the light back in two minutes. {loser} wasted five minutes on the wrong theory.
recap.coop: You find out it was just the fuse and have the light back in two minutes.

recap.default: Nobody could get anything running, so the street is down to commentary on a phone.
recap.coop: Nothing works, so the compound is down to commentary on a phone.

tie.recap: The compound refuses to pick a side and votes for whoever has the bigger TV.

text.default: Twenty people are crammed into a sitting room built for six, all staring at one screen. The best chair is empty for exactly one more second, and {rival} is already eyeing it.
text.coop: Twenty people are crammed into a sitting room built for six, and everyone wants a good view. You and {partner} have to keep the peace and keep the picture.

stakes.default: The best chair, and the room's respect.
stakes.coop: Keeping the room calm during the match.

twists.text: It is {holder}'s house, and everyone knows it.
{holder} is a guest here, and the aunties are watching.
{holder} is getting thanked every ten seconds.

choices.label: Offer drinks to win the best chair
Dive for the chair
Declare the chair reserved
Take the spot with the best view of the screen

recap.default: {winner} sinks into the best chair while {loser} ends up on the floor behind a pillar.
recap.coop: You find the best view in the house and share it.

recap.default: You both end up standing at the back, looking at someone's head.
recap.coop: You both end up standing at the back, looking at someone's head.

tie.recap: Nobody gets the chair, so an aunty claims it and the room moves on.

text.default: One phone is the only thing connecting the street to the match. The commentator says Nigeria are going to penalties, and everyone leans in. {rival} is holding the phone and not sharing.
text.coop: One phone is the only thing connecting the street to the match. You and {partner} have to keep it alive and loud enough for everyone.

stakes.default: The phone, and the story the street tells later.

twists.text: {holder} is the one everyone is standing around.
{holder} can hear only every second word.

choices.label: Beg for the phone with a smile
Grab it and hold it up for everyone
Demand that the volume goes up
Switch to a station with a better signal

recap.default: {winner} ends up holding the phone and acting as commentator. {loser} is told to keep quiet.
recap.coop: You keep the commentary alive and the whole street is with you.

recap.default: The signal drops and all you hear is static, until the crowd down the road starts shouting.
recap.coop: The signal drops and all you hear is static, until the crowd down the road starts shouting.

tie.recap: The phone goes round and the street agrees to share.

text.default: It is penalties. The room goes silent, then explodes, then goes silent again. You and {rival} each put a ₦500 bet on the result, and the whole room knows it.
text.coop: It is penalties. The room goes silent, then explodes, then goes silent again. You and {partner} have to keep everyone calm while the kicks are taken.

stakes.default: ₦500 each, and a month of bragging rights.

twists.text: {holder} has the best view of the screen.
{holder} is watching the penalties through a gap between two heads.

choices.label: Predict the other side will win (reverse psychology)
Raise the bet to ₦1,000
Insult the referee loudly
Stay completely silent so you do not jinx it

recap.default: {winner}'s call is right and {loser} owes ₦500. The room claps.
recap.coop: The kick goes in and the whole room explodes.

recap.default: Both predictions are wrong and the bet is cancelled in shame. The room blames you both.
recap.coop: The kick is saved, and the room blames you for the jinx.

tie.recap: The kick hits the post and bounces out. The bet is void.

text.default: At penalty number four the generator coughs, sputters and dies. Everyone turns to look at you, and {rival} looks very innocent.
text.coop: At penalty number four the generator coughs, sputters and dies. Everyone turns to look at you and {partner}.

stakes.default: Whose fault it is, and who fixes it.
stakes.coop: Getting power back before the last kick.

twists.text: {holder} cannot afford to buy more fuel.
{holder} is still celebrating and not looking at the generator.

choices.label: Calm the room while somebody finds fuel
Sprint to the junction with a jerrycan
Blame somebody loudly
Check whether it is fuel or just the plug

recap.default: {winner} fixes it in seconds while {loser} is still pointing fingers.
recap.coop: You fix it in seconds and the lights come back for the last kick.

recap.default: The fuel spills, the plug blows and the room turns on you both.
recap.coop: The fuel spills, the plug blows and the room turns on you.

tie.recap: The generator restarts on its own and nobody can take credit.

text.default: It is 11 pm and the noise can be heard in the next street. Mama Chidi from downstairs is marching up with a wooden spoon, and {rival} has started pretending to be asleep.
text.coop: It is 11 pm and the noise can be heard in the next street. Mama Chidi from downstairs is marching up with a wooden spoon, and you and {partner} have to handle her.

stakes.default: Who takes the blame for the noise.

twists.text: {holder} is the one who saved the match, and Mama Chidi knows it.
{holder} is the one the whole building is blaming.
It is {holder}'s door she is standing at.

choices.label: Offer her a seat and a bottle of Fanta
Slip out of the back door

lock.reason: It is your house. You cannot slip out of it.

choices.label: Argue that this is a national event
Apologise first and promise to lower the volume

endings.win: The compound will talk about tonight for weeks, and your name is in every version. {loser} is still living it down.
endings.loss: You went home with no chair, no bet and a lecture from Mama Chidi. {winner} will bring it up at every gathering.
endings.draw: The night ends level and the argument goes on until sunrise.
endings.success: The compound survived the match, the generator and Mama Chidi, together.
endings.fail: The lights, the match and the compound's patience all ran out. Next time, buy fuel earlier.

epilogues.text: People will say it was at {holder}'s house that the Super Eagles match was watched.
{holder} is now the compound's official generator person.
{holder} still owes ₦500, and everyone knows it.
{holder} saw half the match through a pillar.
